semantic_map.description: Business meanings and exact SQL recreations for the semantic-map local proof.

meaning.label: Selected region drop rate
meaning.description: The share of the selected region currently classified as dropped.
meaning.formula: drop_pct multiplied by 100 for the current region

evaluator.sql: select drop_pct * 100 as value from public._demo_revenue where region = {{region}}

meaning.label: Selected region retained share
meaning.description: The complement of the selected region drop rate.
meaning.formula: 100 minus the selected region drop rate

evaluator.sql: select (1 - drop_pct) * 100 as value from public._demo_revenue where region = {{region}}

meaning.label: Portfolio average drop rate
meaning.description: The unweighted mean drop rate across every returned region.
meaning.formula: Average of every regional drop_pct multiplied by 100

evaluator.sql: select avg(drop_pct) * 100 as value from public._demo_revenue

meaning.label: Regions above portfolio average
meaning.description: How many regions have a drop rate greater than the current portfolio mean.
meaning.formula: Count of regions where drop_pct exceeds the mean drop_pct

evaluator.sql: select count(*) as value from public._demo_revenue where drop_pct > (select avg(drop_pct) from public._demo_revenue)

meaning.label: Regions represented
meaning.description: The number of regional source rows represented on this dashboard.
meaning.formula: Count of rows in the regional source

evaluator.sql: select count(*) as value from public._demo_revenue

meaning.label: Regional drop rate
meaning.description: The drop rate represented by one regional bar in the comparison.
meaning.formula: drop_pct multiplied by 100 for the bar's region

evaluator.sql: select drop_pct * 100 as value from public._demo_revenue where region = {{region}}
